requirements.title: authenticated user lands on the self attendance page
acceptanceCriteria: The attendance self-view page is reachable after a valid authentication session is established
The page title or heading identifies the attendance context
preconditions: A valid synthetic test user credential is available via environment variable
A storage-state session has been established for that user
The application base URL for the target environment is configured
requirements.expectedOutcome: The attendance self-view page renders without an error state and the authenticated user's identity or the page heading is visible
requirements.source: Derived from application URL https://vyaguta.lftechnology.com/attendance/self/all — no formal requirement doc available. Requires owner approval and auth gap resolution before promotion to active.

requirements.title: self attendance view displays a list of attendance records
acceptanceCriteria: The page contains a table, list, or grid element representing attendance records
At least one record row or an explicit empty-state message is present
preconditions: DH-ATTENDANCE-001 preconditions met
The authenticated test user has at least one attendance record, or the application renders a verified empty-state message when no records exist
requirements.expectedOutcome: A record list or empty-state indicator is visible; no unhandled error message is displayed
requirements.source: Derived from application URL path segment 'all' implying a collection view. Exact column structure, pagination behaviour, and empty-state copy are unverified — requires browser access after auth is resolved.

requirements.title: unauthenticated user is redirected away from the self attendance page
acceptanceCriteria: A request to the attendance self-view URL without a valid session does not render the attendance data
The user is redirected to a login or access-denied page
preconditions: No active session cookie or token is present in the browser context
The application base URL for the target environment is configured
requirements.expectedOutcome: The browser lands on a login or error page, not the attendance record view
requirements.source: Derived from the stated requirement that the application URL requires authentication. Exact redirect target URL and page copy are unverified — requires browser access after auth mechanism is confirmed.

requirements.title: login page loads and displays the authentication form
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the login URL returns a page that renders without an error state
An email input, a password input, and a submit control are visible on the page
preconditions: The application base URL https://www.automationexercise.com/ is reachable
No authenticated session is present in the browser context
requirements.expectedOutcome: The login page renders with its form elements present and no error state visible
requirements.source: Owner specification — login feature, automationexercise.com. Selectors verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.

requirements.title: valid credentials result in an authenticated session
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the pre-existing test account email and the password from TEST_PASSWORD results in a successful authentication
After submission the user is no longer on the login page and no login-error indicator is visible
preconditions: The test account configured via the TEST_EMAIL environment variable exists on the application
The TEST_PASSWORD environment variable is set to the correct password for that account
No authenticated session is present in the browser context at the start of the test
AE-LOGIN-001 preconditions met
requirements.expectedOutcome: The browser navigates away from the login page; the Logout nav link becomes visible, confirming an authenticated session.
requirements.source: Owner specification — core happy-path login, automationexercise.com. CAPTCHA not enforced; Logout link used as authenticated indicator. Verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.

requirements.title: invalid credentials display an error message and deny access
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting an email and password combination that does not match any registered account does not grant an authenticated session
A visible error message is displayed on the login page
The user remains on the login page after the failed attempt
preconditions: The application base URL is reachable
The email used for this test does not correspond to a valid account, or the password is intentionally incorrect
No authenticated session is present in the browser context
requirements.expectedOutcome: Error message 'Your email or password is incorrect!' is displayed; no session established; user remains on /login.
requirements.source: Owner specification — negative login path, automationexercise.com. Error text verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.

requirements.title: product listing page loads and displays products
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /products returns a page that renders without an error state
The heading 'All Products' is visible
At least one product card showing a product name and price is present
preconditions: The application base URL https://www.automationexercise.com/ is reachable
No authenticated session is required — the products page is publicly accessible
requirements.expectedOutcome: The product listing page renders with the 'All Products' heading and at least one product card; no error state is visible
requirements.source: Owner specification — product module, automationexercise.com. Page structure verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-09. Owner approved 2026-10-09.

requirements.title: product detail page loads and displays correct product information
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to a known product detail URL (e.g., /product_details/1) renders without an error state
The product name, price, category, availability, condition, and brand fields are all visible on the page
preconditions: The application base URL is reachable
The target product id exists in the catalog (product_details/1 confirmed as 'Blue Top' during DISCOVER 2026-10-09)
No authenticated session is required
requirements.expectedOutcome: The product detail page renders all six product metadata fields (name, price, category, availability, condition, brand) without an error state
requirements.source: Owner specification — product detail page, automationexercise.com. HTML structure verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-09. Product id stability is an open unknown. Owner approved 2026-10-09.

requirements.title: searching for a known keyword returns matching product results
acceptanceCriteria: Entering a keyword in the search input on /products and activating the search button causes the page to display results
The URL contains the query parameter search={keyword}
The heading changes to 'Searched Products'
At least one product card is visible in the results
preconditions: The product listing page is loaded and the search input is present
The keyword used is known to match at least one product in the catalog (e.g., 'dress' returned 9 results during DISCOVER 2026-10-09)
No authenticated session is required
requirements.expectedOutcome: The page transitions to the search-results view: URL contains ?search={keyword}, heading reads 'Searched Products', and at least one product card is visible
requirements.source: Owner specification — product search, automationexercise.com. Search behavior verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-09 (keyword 'dress' returned 9 results). Owner approved 2026-10-09.

requirements.title: clicking View Product from the listing navigates to the correct product detail page
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'View Product' link on a product card navigates to the product's detail URL (/product_details/{id})
The product detail page renders the same product name that appeared on the listing card
preconditions: The product listing page is loaded with at least one product card visible
No authenticated session is required
requirements.expectedOutcome: Browser navigates to /product_details/{id}; the product name on the detail page matches the name shown on the card that was clicked
requirements.source: Owner specification — product navigation flow, automationexercise.com. Link href pattern /product_details/{id} confirmed via DISCOVER 2026-10-09. Owner approved 2026-10-09.

requirements.title: searching with a keyword that matches no products shows an empty result set
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting a search keyword that matches no catalog product displays the 'Searched Products' heading
No product cards are rendered in the results area
The URL contains search={keyword}
preconditions: The product listing page is loaded
The keyword used is verified to match no product in the catalog
No authenticated session is required
requirements.expectedOutcome: The search-results view renders with 'Searched Products' heading and zero product cards; no error state or crash occurs
requirements.source: Owner specification — edge case, automationexercise.com. Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: cart page loads and shows the correct state for an authenticated user
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /view_cart with an active authenticated session returns the page without an error state
When the cart has at least one item, table#cart_info_table is visible and contains at least one tbody row
When the cart is empty, the #empty_cart element is visible and the table is not present
preconditions: The application base URL https://www.automationexercise.com/ is reachable
A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
requirements.expectedOutcome: The cart page renders without error; the cart table is visible when items are present, and the #empty_cart element is visible when the cart is empty
requirements.source: Owner specification — cart module, automationexercise.com. Page structure verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-12. Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: adding a product from the detail page shows the added-to-cart confirmation modal
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'Add to cart' button on a product detail page while authenticated causes the #cartModal to become visible
The modal heading reads 'Added!'
The modal body contains the text 'Your product has been added to cart.'
A 'View Cart' link and a 'Continue Shopping' button are present in the modal
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
The target product detail page (e.g., /product_details/1) is reachable and the 'Add to cart' button is visible
Any ad overlay that may intercept modal interaction has been dismissed or waited out
requirements.expectedOutcome: The #cartModal appears with heading 'Added!', body confirmation text, a 'View Cart' link, and a 'Continue Shopping' button
requirements.source: Owner specification — add-to-cart flow, automationexercise.com. Modal structure (#cartModal, heading, body, links) verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-12. Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: cart page displays correct product name, unit price, quantity, and line total for each item
acceptanceCriteria: Each cart item row on /view_cart shows the product name in .cart_description h4 a
Each row shows the unit price in .cart_price p in the format 'Rs. {amount}'
Each row shows the quantity in .cart_quantity button.disabled
Each row shows the line total in .cart_total p.cart_total_price in the format 'Rs. {amount}'
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
At least one product has been added to the cart before the test (setup step required)
The known product's name and price are recorded for assertion (e.g., product_details/1 is 'Blue Top' at Rs. 500)
requirements.expectedOutcome: Each cart item row renders product name, unit price, quantity, and line total without any field missing or showing an error state
requirements.source: Owner specification — cart display accuracy, automationexercise.com. Row HTML structure verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-12 (product 1 'Blue Top', Rs. 500). Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: removing an item from the cart removes its row and shows empty state when the last item is deleted
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the a.cart_quantity_delete link for a cart item removes that item's tbody row from the DOM
If the deleted item was the only item, #empty_cart becomes visible and table#cart_info_table is no longer visible
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
At least one product has been added to the cart before the test
The cart page /view_cart is loaded with the item visible in the table
requirements.expectedOutcome: The deleted item's row is removed from the cart table without a full page reload; when the last item is removed, #empty_cart is visible and no table is rendered
requirements.source: Owner specification — remove-item flow, automationexercise.com. Async DOM update confirmed in DISCOVER 2026-10-12 (three items deleted sequentially; #empty_cart appeared after last delete). Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: cart line total equals unit price multiplied by displayed quantity for each item
acceptanceCriteria: For each cart item row, the numeric value in .cart_total p.cart_total_price equals the numeric value in .cart_price p multiplied by the numeric value in .cart_quantity button.disabled
The assertion holds for at least one item with quantity 1 (minimum observed case)
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
At least one product has been added to the cart with a known quantity
The cart page /view_cart is loaded with the item visible
requirements.expectedOutcome: The line total value matches unit price times quantity for every item row; no arithmetic discrepancy is present
requirements.source: Owner specification — cart total accuracy, automationexercise.com. Quantity editing not observed in DISCOVER 2026-10-12 (quantity shown as read-only button); minimum case is quantity=1. Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: clicking View Cart from the add-to-cart modal navigates to the cart page
acceptanceCriteria: After adding a product to the cart, the confirmation modal (#cartModal) is visible
Clicking the 'View Cart' link inside the modal navigates to /view_cart
The cart page loads and the added product is present in the cart table
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
A product detail page is loaded and the 'Add to cart' button is accessible
The add-to-cart confirmation modal (#cartModal) is visible after clicking 'Add to cart'
requirements.expectedOutcome: Browser navigates to /view_cart and the cart table contains the product that was just added
requirements.source: Owner specification — cart modal View Cart flow, automationexercise.com. Modal structure verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-12. Ad overlay risk noted. Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: clicking Continue Shopping from the add-to-cart modal dismisses the modal and stays on the product detail page
acceptanceCriteria: After adding a product to the cart, the confirmation modal (#cartModal) is visible
Clicking the 'Continue Shopping' button dismisses the modal
The product detail page remains visible after dismissal — the URL still matches /product_details/{id}
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
A product detail page is loaded and the 'Add to cart' button is accessible
The add-to-cart confirmation modal (#cartModal) is visible after clicking 'Add to cart'
requirements.expectedOutcome: The modal closes and the user remains on the same product detail page; no navigation occurs
requirements.source: Owner specification — cart modal Continue Shopping flow, automationexercise.com. Modal structure verified via DISCOVER 2026-10-12. Ad overlay risk noted. Owner approved 2026-10-12.

requirements.title: submitting an empty login form shows a validation error
acceptanceCriteria: Activating the submit control while both the email and password fields are empty produces a visible validation indicator
No authenticated session is established
preconditions: The login page is rendered with the form in its default empty state
No authenticated session is present in the browser context
requirements.expectedOutcome: A validation error or browser-native field constraint is visible; the user remains on the login page without a session
requirements.source: Owner specification — empty-form edge case, automationexercise.com. Client-side HTML5 validation confirmed via DISCOVER 2026-10-08. Owner approved 2026-10-08.

requirements.title: checkout page loads and displays pre-filled delivery address, billing address, and order comment section for an authenticated user with items in cart
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /checkout after adding at least one product to the cart returns a page that renders without an error state
The #address_delivery section is visible and contains address text
The #address_invoice section is visible and contains address text
The order comment textarea (textarea.form-control) is visible and accepts text input
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
At least one product has been added to the cart before the test
The user has navigated from /view_cart by clicking 'Proceed To Checkout', or /checkout is loaded directly with the session and cart state intact
The test account has a pre-filled delivery and billing address (required for address sections to render with content)
requirements.expectedOutcome: The checkout page renders at /checkout without error; #address_delivery and #address_invoice sections are visible and contain address text; textarea.form-control is present and editable
requirements.source: Derived from cart module-context.md (checkout page selectors confirmed via DISCOVER 2026-10-12) and owner specification. Owner approved 2026-10-14. DISCOVER skipped by owner.

requirements.title: payment page loads and displays card detail input fields after clicking Place Order on the checkout page
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Place Order' on /checkout navigates to /payment without an error state
The payment form is visible and contains fields for name on card, card number, CVC, expiration month, and expiration year
A payment submission button is present on the page
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
At least one product has been added to the cart before the test
The checkout page (/checkout) is loaded with address sections visible (AE-CHECKOUT-001 preconditions met)
The 'Place Order' button (a.btn.btn-default.check_out) is visible on the checkout page
requirements.expectedOutcome: Browser navigates to /payment; the payment form renders with all expected card-detail fields visible; no error state is shown
requirements.source: Derived from cart module-context.md (href='/payment' observed on Place Order link) and owner specification. Owner approved 2026-10-14. DISCOVER skipped by owner.

requirements.title: submitting valid card details on the payment page results in an order confirmation page
acceptanceCriteria: Entering synthetic card values (name, card number, CVC, expiry month, expiry year) in all payment form fields and activating the submission button does not show a payment error
The browser navigates to an order confirmation page after payment submission
A success heading or confirmation message is visible on the resulting page
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
At least one product has been added to the cart before the test
The payment page (/payment) has been reached via the full checkout flow from /view_cart
Synthetic card values are known to be accepted by the automationexercise.com payment form (requires DISCOVER to confirm)
requirements.expectedOutcome: After payment form submission, the browser lands on an order confirmation page with a visible success message; no error state or payment rejection message is shown
requirements.source: Derived from owner specification — checkout happy path e2e coverage. Mutation: places a real order on the demo site. Owner approved 2026-10-14. DISCOVER confirmed 2026-10-14.

requirements.title: order confirmation page displays a unique order ID after successful payment submission
acceptanceCriteria: Following a successful payment submission (AE-CHECKOUT-003 preconditions met), the confirmation page displays an order ID or order number
The displayed order ID is a non-empty string or number that can be read from the DOM
preconditions: AE-CHECKOUT-003 preconditions are met and the payment form has been submitted successfully
The browser has navigated to the order confirmation page
requirements.expectedOutcome: A unique order ID or order number is visible on the confirmation page; it is readable from the DOM and non-empty
requirements.source: Derived from owner specification — confirmation page coverage. Confirmation page route /payment_done/{id} and order ID in URL (not DOM) confirmed. Owner approved 2026-10-14. DISCOVER confirmed 2026-10-14.

requirements.title: order comment entered on the checkout page is accepted without validation error before proceeding to payment
acceptanceCriteria: Entering text in the order comment textarea (textarea.form-control) on /checkout does not produce a validation error
After entering a comment, clicking 'Place Order' navigates to /payment without an error state
The textarea accepts free-form text input without character-limit errors for a typical comment length (up to 200 characters)
preconditions: A valid authenticated session is established via storageState (TEST_EMAIL / TEST_PASSWORD)
At least one product has been added to the cart before the test
The checkout page (/checkout) is loaded with the comment textarea visible (AE-CHECKOUT-001 preconditions met)
requirements.expectedOutcome: Text is entered in the comment textarea without error; clicking 'Place Order' navigates to /payment as expected; no validation rejection is shown
requirements.source: Derived from owner specification — comment textarea on /checkout confirmed via cart module DISCOVER 2026-10-12 (selector textarea.form-control). Navigation to /payment after comment entry confirmed end-to-end. Owner approved 2026-10-14. DISCOVER confirmed 2026-10-14.
